name: windows-xp-living-desktop
description: Windows XP desktop simulation for web hosting, with a Rust/WebAssembly simulation core and optional Electron runtime

scripts.build:wasm: cd rust-core && wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir ../ui/wasm-core --out-name xp_core
scripts.check: node --check main.js && node --check preload.js && node --check scripts/serve-web.js && node --check ui/host-adapter.js && node --check scripts/web-adapter-smoke.js && node --check ui/desktop.js && node --check ui/modules/event-bus.js && node --check ui/modules/storage-manager.js && node --check ui/modules/ai-engine.js && node --check ui/modules/window-manager.js && node --check ui/modules/context-menu.js && node --check ui/modules/stickman-runtime.js
scripts.test: node scripts/smoke-test.js && node scripts/main-process-smoke.js && node scripts/web-adapter-smoke.js && node scripts/web-target-smoke.js
